name: Togitsu (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Togitsu town emblem in white: a ring with a small notch at the top, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Togitsu, a town in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 1951.

features.role: Togitsu town emblem — a ring with a small notch at the top, like a stylised character
